data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘वल्लभ’ (Valabha), which means 'bold' or 'brave'. This name is associated with the deity Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted as a warrior protecting the universe from evil. The name Ballu carries the meaning “Bold Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ballu usually hope their child will grow to embody bold warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
